Socratix

Aug 2025–Jun 2026

Socratic AI math tutor

Socratix evolved from guided mathematics learning and dynamic visualizations for LIDM 2025 into a multi-agent Socratic tutor. The later prototype combines a Next.js interface with a NestJS pipeline for routing, planning, deterministic math validation, and streamed interactive scenes. My contribution focused on the AI routing and planning pipeline.

AI engineering
Source code Technical roadmap Project video

Problem

Turn varied student questions into structured math problems that a tutoring pipeline can validate and explain.

My role

AI and backend engineering: designed the router and planner pipeline with Groq and NestJS, including input classification and context extraction.

Approach

Combined regex routing with an LLM fallback through the Vercel AI SDK. Zod schemas validate extracted equations, problem types, and parameters.

Key decision

The pipeline checks equations through Math.js before generating guidance. Defensive error handling and prompt-injection mitigations help manage unexpected inputs.

Result

The router correctly classified all 20 examples in a small project evaluation using the live Groq API.

Recognition

11th place in the AI for Education track at the ASEAN AI Hackathon (May 2026) and 1st place at UNSRAT in the LIDM Digital Education Technology Innovation division (September 2025).

Illustrative request flow

Route and plan

For a request like 3x + 5 = 14, the router identifies the problem type, variables, and known values.

Validate

Math.js AST substitution checks equations before the response is generated.

Guide

The tutoring agent builds a step-by-step Socratic prompt and requests the next useful visual.

Visualize

The visual agent plans a balance scale, fraction bar, number line, or coordinate scene.
